source.rationale: The pre-`resolutions` resolver shape is still supported: with no resolutions array but a populated unresolved_tokens, the whole resolver object is treated as ONE resolution and the token label falls back through unresolved_tokens[0]. That shape also carries no entity_type, so entity_type comes out null and for_hint falls back to the PARSER entity's hint -- the two halves of the FINDING-2 fallback in one case. Dropping this branch would silently stop offering did-you-means on that shape rather than fail loudly.
